title: Digital Analytics Manager
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Marketing

**General Summary:**

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Digital Analytics Manager will support enterprise digital analytics operations by translating Business Measurement Requirements (BRDs) into Solution Design Reference (SDRs) including data-layer design, web tagging, validation, governance, and reporting solutions. The role partners with marketing, legal privacy, IT, development teams, platform owners, and external agencies to implement and sustain reliable analytics across websites and digital experiences. The position combines hands-on Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collection expertise with structured project follow-through, quality assurance, issue triage, documentation, and stakeholder coordination

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Implement and enhance website and application analytics using Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, Adobe Data Layer patterns, events, variables, report suites, segments, and calculated metrics.

* Translate business requirements into measurement specifications, data-layer requirements, solution design references, pixel intake requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria.

* Perform stage and production QA/UAT for page views, search interactions, downloads, login events, campaign pixels, consent signals, URL-based behaviors, and other digital interactions.

* Maintain analytics privacy and data-minimization requirements by identifying unintended user-data collection, defining remediation requirements, validating changes, and escalating unresolved risks.

* Support consent-management integrations and validation, including alignment between consent signals, Adobe Web SDK/Data Collection, analytics behavior, and regional privacy requirements.

* Conduct analytics environment governance activities, including audits and cleanup of unused segments and calculated metrics, documentation maintenance, naming standards, and configuration hygiene.

* Monitor analytics health through alerts, anomaly review, website scans, tag validation, and investigation of broken or inconsistent tracking.

* Coordinate work through Workfront, Jira, ServiceNow, email, and recurring backlog reviews; create and follow up on tickets, track dependencies, communicate blockers, and confirm production completion.

* Prepare recurring project status updates and supporting documentation for analytics operations, including in-flight work, backlog, risks, completion status, and next steps.

* Provide tool support, access administration, knowledge transfer, and technical guidance for Adobe Analytics and related MarTech platforms.

* Collaborate across time zones with internal teams, consultants, agencies, and vendors, serving as a technical point of contact for analytics implementation and validation work.

* Maintain the platform roadmap and backlog; prioritize enhancements with stakeholders

* Build and maintain operational dashboards for usage, adoption, and operational metrics

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years administering enterprise Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collections

* Demonstrated experience implementing and validating digital analytics for websites or web applications.

* Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, browser debugging, data layers, events, variables, segments, calculated metrics, and report-suite validation.

* Ability to read technical requirements, inspect browser behavior, test across stage and production environments, and clearly document defects and expected outcomes.

* Experience coordinating work with software developers, IT teams, product owners, analytics stakeholders, privacy partners, agencies, and vendors.

* Working knowledge of digital privacy, consent signals, data minimization, and responsible collection of user-related information.

* Experience using work-management and incident-tracking systems such as Workfront, Jira, and ServiceNow.

* Strong written communication, follow-through, documentation, prioritization, and cross-time-zone collaboration skills.

* Knowledge of analytics governance practices, naming conventions, solution design documentation, dashboard delivery, and operational reporting.

* Adobe Analytics or related digital analytics certification is beneficial.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.

OR
  
Associate's degree or equivalent degree and 5+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
  
OR
  
High school Diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
  
  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

title: Business Analyst Global Business Services
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Independent Business & Books Analysis

* Understand the client’s business model, revenue streams, cost structures and operating processes.
* Independently review books of accounts and transaction patterns.
* Assess whether accounting treatment appropriately reflects the underlying business transactions.
* Identify new transaction types, products, vendors, customers, business developments and operational changes.
* Review unusual, high-value or recurring transactions and assess their accounting and reporting implications.
* Identify gaps between actual business operations and the existing accounting/process framework.

2. Chart of Accounts & Accounting Structure

* Review the existing Chart of Accounts (COA) based on changes in the client’s business.
* Identify requirements for new GLs, classifications, cost centres or reporting categories.
* Assess whether the accounting structure supports meaningful MIS and management reporting.
* Recommend and coordinate approved structural changes with the relevant finance/accounting team.

3. KTS Ownership & Maintenance

* Periodically review and update the client’s Key Transaction Sheet.
* Map business activities and transaction types to appropriate accounting, compliance and reporting treatment.
* Add new transaction flows and modify existing transaction classifications.
* Identify transactions requiring specific accounting, GST, TDS, payroll, FEMA or other regulatory consideration.
* Maintain appropriate version control and documentation of changes.
* Ensure the KTS reflects the current business reality rather than historical processes.

4. MIS & Reporting Framework

* Review existing MIS formats against management requirements.
* Identify additional reporting requirements arising from changes in the business.
* Recommend appropriate classifications, reporting heads and analytical dimensions.
* Ensure consistency between Business Activity → Accounting Treatment → KTS → MIS → Compliance Reporting. 5. Compliance & Regulatory Alignment **Identify transactions with potential statutory or regulatory implications.**  Flag changes that may affect GST, TDS, income tax, payroll, FEMA, ROC or other applicable compliance. **Coordinate with the Compliance team for technical interpretation wherever required.**  Ensure identified compliance implications are appropriately incorporated into the KTS and operating instructions. 6. Process Design & Operations Guidance **Prepare practical accounting treatment and transaction classification instructions for Operations.**  Define documentation requirements and new controls/checkpoints where required. **Communicate KTS, MIS and compliance-related process changes to the Operations team.**  Track implementation of approved process changes. 7. Periodic End-to-End Review **Conduct structured reviews covering Business → Transactions → Books → KTS → COA → MIS → Compliance → Operations.**  Identify what has changed, what is new, what is obsolete, and what requires revised treatment. **Document findings, required actions, responsible teams and closure status.**

Qualification: CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance or equivalent finance qualification preferred. Strong accounting fundamentals are essential. Experience: 2–5 years in business analysis, finance controllership, accounting advisory, management reporting, financial operations, audit, transaction analysis or finance process consulting. Experience with startups/SMEs and multi-entity businesses is preferred. Technical Skills **Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.**  Chart of Accounts, general ledger structure and transaction mapping. **MIS and management reporting.**  GST and TDS fundamentals. **Financial processes and internal controls.**  Excel/Google Sheets and process documentation. **ERP/accounting systems and transaction-level data analysis are advantageous. Behavioural Competencies**  Analytical and independent approach rather than routine execution orientation. **Strong ability to understand the commercial context behind accounting entries.**  Comfortable asking questions and challenging existing processes constructively. **Detail-oriented while retaining an end-to-end business perspective.**  Strong documentation and communication skills. **Ability to translate technical observations into practical operating instructions. Performance Metrics / KPIs**  Timeliness and completeness of periodic KTS reviews. **Accuracy and quality of KTS updates.**  Quality and relevance of business/process gaps identified. **Closure of identified accounting and process gaps.**  Timeliness of communication and implementation of process changes. **Reduction in recurring accounting/compliance errors.**  Alignment between business activity and accounting treatment. **Quality of MIS/COA improvement recommendations.**  Quality of documentation and audit trail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Business IT Systems Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose:**  
The Business Analyst’s role is to elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project stakeholders, be they customers or end-users. This includes interviewing stakeholders and gathering and compiling user requirements to create functional design specifications that can be used by development teams throughout the software lifecycle. In addition it is the responsibility of this role to plan, design, develop, and launch efficient business, financial, and operations systems in support of core organizational functions and business processes. This includes gathering and analyzing data in support of business cases, proposed projects, and systems requirements. The Business Analyst is also responsible for generating and compiling reports based on their findings, complete with probable causes and possible solutions to systems issues. This individual will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of IT system investments. Moreover the Business Analyst will initiate the creation of test cases and lead business users through the testing of new solutions. Works with the QA and Training team to document system scenarios and identifies roles impacted
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborate with project managers and project sponsors to determine project scope.
* Clearly identify project stakeholders and establish user classes, as well as their characteristics.
* Conduct interviews and product analysis to gather user requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Meet with decision makers, systems owners, and end users to define business, financial, and operations requirements and systems goals, and identify and resolve systems issues.
* Develop and utilize standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirement specifications.
* Translate conceptual user requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Where necessary, develop prototypes of interfaces and attributes based on findings. Lead design sessions in prototyping new systems for the purpose of enhancing business processes, operations, and information process flow
* Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Identify and establish scope and parameters of requirements analysis in order to define impact, outcome criteria, and measure-taking actions.
* Work with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications – verbally or through written documentation project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* Review and analyze the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and develop strategies for improving or further leveraging these systems.
* Perform cost-benefit and return on investment analyses for proposed systems to aid management in making implementation decisions.
* Coordinate and perform in-depth tests, including end-user reviews, for modified and new systems, and other post-implementation support.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability of in-house computing systems.
* Assist in conducting research on software and hardware products to justify recommendations and to support purchasing efforts.
* Provide orientation and training to end users for all modified and new systems
* Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members.

Knowledge Skills and Experience
  
  

* College diploma or university degree in the field of business administration, computer science, finance, or information systems and 5 years related work experience.
* Proven experience in overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software and hardware solutions, systems, or products
* Ability to create systematic and consistent requirements specifications in both technical and user-friendly language.
* Ability to apply statistical and other research methods into systems issues and products as required.
* Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including MS Project.
* Working technical knowledge of scripting languages, network and PC operating systems.
* Able to exercise independent judgement and take action on it.
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills.
* Excellent understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
* Highly self motivated and directed.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks while under pressure.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Excellent English language skills

description:

Shape the future of derivatives operations by strengthening controls, delivering change with cross-functional partners, and building a platform for career mobility and growth.

As a Trade Support Analyst within Derivatives Trade Support, you manage day-to-day trade support processes across booking, verification, and reconciliations while maintaining strong systems and control discipline. You lead defined deliveries and change initiatives by partnering with technology, legal, and compliance stakeholders to implement improvements and reduce operational risk. You build and maintain control frameworks, management information, and trend analysis to improve transparency, performance, and decision-making.

* Oversee trade booking, verification, and reconciliation activities to support accurate and timely processing.
* Coordinate day-to-day production planning and workload balancing to sustain stable operational delivery.
* Build an appropriate control framework aligned to transaction lifecycle risks, system touchpoints, and control ownership.
* Produce management information and key performance indicators, including trend analysis, to monitor performance and identify issues.
* Partner with technology, legal, and compliance stakeholders to implement operational changes and deliver the operations agenda.

* Analyze breaks, exceptions, and process issues using numerical and analytical skills to determine root causes and actions.

--------------------------------

**Overview**

Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

**TTS Analytics C12**

**What do we do?**

* The TTS Analytics team provides analytical insights to the Product, Pricing, Client Experience and Sales functions within the global Treasury & Trade Services business. The team works on business problems focused on enhancing client experience, driving acquisitions, cross-sell and revenue growth.
* The team extracts relevant insights, identifies business opportunities, converts business problems into analytical frameworks, uses big data tools and AI/ML techniques to drive data driven business outcomes in collaboration with business and product partners.
* The team works on building and operating Generative AI and deep learning solutions - Design, implement, and scale production‑grade AI applications end‑to‑end—from data ingestion and model services to user‑facing interfaces, observability, and secure deployments.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION**

The role will be AVP (C12) in the TTS Analytics team.

The role will involve working on

* As a key contributor to ideation on analytical projects to tackle strategic business priorities.
* The role will require endless curiosity, as ambiguity and open-ended questions are a core part of the team’s work.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of AI‑powered products: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
* Design, build, and maintain automated, scalable evaluation pipelines and frameworks (e.g., using LLM-Eval-Harness, or custom internal frameworks).
* Curate, version, and synthetically augment high-quality ground-truth ("golden") datasets covering diverse use cases, edge cases, domain-specific tasks, and adversarial vectors.
* Implement metric suites evaluating task accuracy, semantic similarity, faithfulness, hallucination rates, toxicity, relevancy, bias, deterministic constraint satisfaction, and tool/agent execution fidelity.
* Establish statistically sound LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation protocols, human-in-the-loop (HITL) calibration workflows, and deterministic/statistical baseline checks (BLEU, ROUGE, Exact Match, BERTScore).
* Formulate automated test suites and migration runbooks to transition production workloads across model versions with minimal disruption and validated parity.
* Develop structured, reproducible prompt architectures using advanced techniques (Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct, DSPy, Automated Prompt Optimization).
* Analyze and optimize token budgets, prompt caching, model routing strategies (e.g., small SLMs for routing/extraction vs. large frontier models for complex reasoning), and speculative decoding strategies.
* Enforce schema compliance (JSON schema, Pydantic, function calling / tool definitions) and deterministic constraints across varying foundation model backends.
* Partner closely with platform architects, MLOps, backend engineers, and data engineers to integrate evaluation artifacts directly into CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
* Lead the AI governance process
* Author comprehensive Object Development Documentation (ODD), Model Validation packages, model risk assessments, and technical artifacts detailing model design, limitation boundaries, training/evaluation data lineage, and testing methodologies.
* Engage early with new AI initiative owners to scope evaluation criteria, acceptable error thresholds, bias assessments, and testing requirements prior to production onboarding.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Ability to build partnerships with cross-function leaders.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience:**

* Overall 8+ years of experience. 5+ years of Data Science/ML engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years dedicated to Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, and evaluation frameworks.

Must have substantial experience in:

* Strong proficiency in **Python** (async/concurrency, FastAPI/Pydantic, pytest) and standard data analysis stacks (Pandas, NumPy).

* Hands-on experience with modern LLM tooling such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, etc..

* Deep understanding of quantitative evaluation metrics (Semantic similarity, Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Precision/Recall, Hallucination scoring, Toxicity).

* Experience building structured dataset curation pipelines, data cleansing, versioning (like S3), and synthetic data generation techniques.

* Observability: application monitoring, centralized logging, tracing; strong debugging and problem‑resolution skills.

* AI Governance

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in financial services, healthcare, or heavily regulated enterprise environments, particularly with Model Risk Governance

* Experience evaluating complex multi-step reasoning, tool-calling agents, memory systems, and Multi-Agent Orchestration frameworks.

* Knowledge of data privacy and responsible AI practices; experience implementing audit and guardrail tooling.

**Education:**

* Bachelor / Masters (preferred) in Computer Science Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or related technical disciplines (or equivalent practical experience).

* Proactively identify opportunities to improve support processes, efficiency, quality, and customer experience.

* Demonstrate proven examples of using AI to deliver faster, more efficient, higher-quality, or higher-value outcomes.

  
**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in Product Support, Application Support, Business Analysis, or a similar client-facing support role.
* Experience working in client-facing roles and directly supporting international clients, preferably across US and/or European geographies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform issue analysis, data interpretation, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience working with UAT, Pre-Production, and Production environments, including smoke testing and sanity testing.
* Experience creating or executing test scenarios, test scripts, and validating application changes.

* Proficiency in using AI/Generative AI/LLM tools for research, analysis, documentation, testing, and productivity improvement, with the ability to validate outputs and manage associated risks.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced, SLA-driven environment and drive issues through to resolution.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and result-oriented with strong time-management skills.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including European and/or US business hours.
* Ability to quickly learn new products, technologies, processes, and AI-enabled tools.
* Experience with chat support is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ability to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through effective communication and service delivery.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* BE / BTech / ME / MTech / BCA / MCA / BCS / MCS or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience using AI or Generative AI tools to improve support operations, testing, documentation, analysis, or process efficiency.
* Exposure to AI agents, agent-based workflows, AI automation, or building simple AI-enabled workflows is preferred.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you'll help keep the firm strong and resilient by anticipating emerging risks and applying sound judgment to solve real-world challenges for our company, customers, and communities. Our culture values curiosity, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class.

Job Summary

As a Quantitative Research Analyst, Wholesale Credit Risk Modeling within Risk Management and Compliance, you will design, analyze, and deliver quantitative models that support wholesale credit stress testing, internal capital planning, risk appetite frameworks, and loan loss reserves under current expected credit loss standards. You will use statistical techniques and tools to build forecasting models and run back-testing and annual monitoring in line with model governance standards. You will work with experienced quantitative researchers and business partners while building both quantitative and business skills. You will contribute to clear model documentation and communication of model results for internal and regulatory reviews.

Job Responsibilities

* Design and develop loss forecasting models for regulatory purposes.
* Conduct back-testing, performance monitoring, and annual reviews of models in line with model governance standards.
* Apply statistical and econometric techniques, and machine learning where appropriate, for forecasting, risk monitoring, and model explainability.
* Handle large-scale panel datasets, including data cleaning, filtering, and feature engineering.

* Prepare clear, comprehensive model documentation for internal and regulatory reviews, and support preparation of results and model impacts for senior stakeholders.

* Experience handling large amounts of panel data, including data cleaning and filtering.
* Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language and proficiency in Python or C++, with good software practices (version control, testing, reproducibility).
* Ability to solve problems creatively in a dynamic environment, with eagerness to learn about credit risk, risk parameters, and regulatory and accounting concepts.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

description:
:

**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

  
:

**Insights & Analytics**

**ZS's** **Insights & Analytics** **group** partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.

**The role**
------------

A build-and-advise role. You lead build pods on AI-enabled analytics products and independently own core commercial analytics problems for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 60/40 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You own workstream-level delivery, manage 2–4 Associates / Associate Consultants, and are the day-to-day technical counterpart for client analytics and enterprise-AI stakeholders.

This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. When build demand is low, you are staffed on core analytics workstreams for the same client; when it is high, you lead the build. Both halves are required.

**What** **You’ll** **Do**

* ### **AI & analytics engineering (~60%)**

  Own end-to-end build of insight pipelines on Databricks: certified Delta tables metric layer signal detection LLM narrative
  + application surface.
  + Design agentic workflows on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent): tool design, context and prompt engineering, governed context stores, fallbacks and failure handling.
  + Enforce guardrails in data and metadata — governed tables, SQL-level scope control — rather than in prompt instructions.
  + Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output: answer-quality rubrics, binary gates (numerical fidelity, grounding, compliance), regression suites, release gates; tracing via Langfuse/LangSmith or equivalent.
  + Deliver conversational analytics (NL-to-SQL) on governed semantic layers (Databricks Genie, Metric Views) with certified KPI definitions.
  + Set engineering standards: code review, Git/CI, unit and SIT test plans, UAT support, release notes, observability, cost and latency tracking.
  + Produce architecture documents, security / IT-risk evidence packs and status reporting with honest status legends (implemented / in-flight / planned / blocked).

  ### **Core commercial analytics (~40%)**

  + Take ambiguous questions from any client function — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, supply chain, enterprise operations — and structure them into decision-oriented analytical plans; own them end to end.
  + Pick the method the question needs — diagnostic analysis, cohort and longitudinal analysis, segmentation, forecasting, test-and-control and causal inference, predictive modelling, optimisation — and defend the choice.
  + Work across the client's data estate — syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer and access data, operational and financial data — integrating sources and resolving definitional conflicts.
  + Establish governed definitions (KPIs, cohorts, business rules) with the client and make them enforceable in code — one definition, every surface.
  + Convert results into decisions: QC'd, client-ready narratives and decks; activation into workflows, dashboards or products; present to Director+ stakeholders.

  ### **Client & team leadership**

  + Plan, review and coach a team of 2–4; QC everything before it reaches the client.
  + Own workstream status, risks and dependencies with ZS leadership and client PMO.
  + Contribute to proposals, POVs and CST capability building — reusable assets and AI upskilling of CST talent.

**What** **You’ll** **Bring**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
* 5 – 8 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
* **SQL — expert.** Window functions, cohort and longitudinal logic, performance tuning on claims-scale data.
* **Python — production-grade.** pandas/PySpark, packaging, testing, Git; you have owned code others depend on.
* **Lakehouse platform —** Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Spark, Workflows) or comparable (Snowflake/BigQuery + Spark).
* **LLM application engineering —** Prompt and context engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or equivalent), evaluation and monitoring. You can explain how your system failed and what you changed.
* **Applied analytics —** solving business problems in a stakeholder-facing role, spanning more than one method family: diagnostic and cohort/longitudinal analysis, segmentation, test-and-control / causal inference, forecasting, predictive modelling; statistical rigour and explicit QC. Life-sciences or healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred — any function (commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, operations); hands-on with real-world data (claims, EHR, registries), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* **Consulting skills.** Structure ambiguity, own deliverables end to end, communicate crisply in PowerPoint, Excel and in the room.
* **People leadership.** Has led 2+ people on delivery with accountability for their output quality.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

:

* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.

**The role**
------------

A hands-on build-and-analyze role. You own modules within AI-enabled analytics products and independently deliver core commercial analytics workstreams for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 50/50 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You work under a Consultant, guide Associates on your modules, and interact directly with client analysts and product owners.

This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. You will be staffed across build and analytics work for the same client depending on demand. Both halves are required.

**What** **You’ll** **Do**

* ### **AI & analytics engineering (~50%)**

  + Build and maintain pipeline components on Databricks: Delta transformations, metric views, signal-detection logic, LLM narrative steps, app-facing data contracts.
  + Implement agent tools, prompts and context assets on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent); write the unit and regression tests that go with them.
  + Run evaluation harnesses: score LLM outputs against rubrics, triage failures, log defects, propose fixes.
  + Implement data-layer guardrails (governed tables, scope-controlling joins) and KPI canonicalization in code.
  + Support SIT/UAT: test cases, evidence capture, defect lifecycle in JIRA.

  ### **Core commercial analytics (~50%)**

  + Deliver analyses across client functions — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, enterprise operations — under Consultant direction, from data pull to insight.
  + Apply the appropriate method — descriptive and diagnostic analysis, cohorts, segmentation, forecasting basics, test-and-control — and explain why it fits.
  + Work hands-on with varied data: syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer, operational and financial data.
  + QC your own work — reconciliation to source, benchmark and sanity checks — and turn analysis into clear slides and written summaries for client review.

  ### **Team**

  + Guide 1–2 Associates on module-level work; review their code and outputs.
  + Own status and blockers for your modules; escalate early.

**What** **You’ll** **Bring**

* Bachelor's or master's degree required in any discipline with strong record of academic success in quantitative and analytic coursework such as operations research, applied mathematics, management science, data science, statistics, econometrics or engineering.
* 2-5 years of relevant post-collegiate job experience. A PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience.
* **SQL — strong.** Window functions, cohort logic, joins across large tables.
* **Python — strong.** pandas/PySpark, functions and modules, tests, Git.
* **LLM application hands-on —** Prompt and context engineering, RAG or tool calling; at least one application built end to end with a documented evaluation approach. Agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph) a plus.
* **Applied analytics —** translating business questions into analysis with QC: descriptive and diagnostic analysis, cohorts, segmentation, test-and-control, forecasting basics. Life-sciences or healthcare data experience preferred — any function; exposure to real-world data (claims, EHR), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* Clear written summaries and slides; comfortable presenting your own work to clients.
* Delivers modules end to end; asks the right questions early.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

We are seeking a Senior Technical Lead with strong expertise in cloud architecture, data engineering, Agentic AI and DevOps practices on Google Cloud Platform. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can design scalable cloud solutions, build robust data platforms, and drive automation using modern DevOps and engineering cloud platform as service and engineer platform services as product

You will lead engineering teams, define technical direction, and deliver secure, high-performance, and cost-optimized cloud solutions and build production-grade GenAI and ML services on **GCP**. You’ll own core platform components for **hybrid RAG**, **vector + graph data stores**, **multi-agent orchestration,** and secure tool connectivity (including **MCP-style** patterns).

Enthusiast to explore new tools and perform POC to evaluate tools and build solutions

**Key Responsibilities**

* **GCP Cloud Architecture & Modernisation**: Design and deliver scalable, secure, resilient solutions on GCP; lead architecture reviews and technical decisions; drive cloud modernisation and migration.
* **API-first Services for LLM Applications**: Design and implement scalable, reusable API-first backend services enabling LLM/agent use cases.
* **High-performance & Resilient Systems**: Build low-latency, high-throughput systems with strong caching, batching, retries, idempotency, and fallback patterns.
* **GCP Service Integration & Operations**: Integrate and operate key GCP services (Cloud Run/GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, Logging/Monitoring).
* **Data Engineering & Analytics Platform**: Build and optimise batch and real-time pipelines using BigQuery, Dataflow, Composer/Airflow, and Pub/Sub; ensure governance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* **Enterprise Tool Connectivity (MCP-style)**: Implement secure, standardised connectors to internal APIs/data sources with authN/authZ, rate limiting, audit logging, and policy checks; maintain a versioned tool registry/catalogue with schema compatibility guarantees.
* **LLMOps/MLOps Reliability, Evaluation & Observability**: Build automated evaluation harnesses (golden sets, regression, red-teaming, retrieval metrics); implement tracing across agent steps, prompt/version tracking, and cost/latency dashboards; harden with SLOs, runbooks, and safe rollouts (canary/blue-green).
* **DevOps Automation & Technical Leadership**: Deliver IaC with Terraform and CI/CD for cloud/data workloads; automate deployments and environment provisioning; develop Python automation/frameworks and reusable accelerators; mentor engineers, enforce standards, and collaborate with product/analytics/security to drive delivery accountability.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience**: 12–15+ years in IT, including 5+ years hands-on in GCP architecture, data engineering, and AI/agentic AI solutions.
* **GCP & Data Platform Expertise**: Strong in core GCP services (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer, GCE, GCS, GKE, etc.).
* **Cloud-Native Backend Engineering**: Proven delivery of production microservices/APIs and distributed systems; strong foundations in async, concurrency, and performance profiling.
* **Python & LLM Engineering**: Strong Python (preferred for LLM/RAG); hands-on LLM integration (embeddings, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt/version management).
* **RAG & Retrieval Systems**: Delivered RAG solutions, ideally hybrid (dense + sparse) with reranking; experience with vector DBs (indexing, tuning, multi-tenancy) and embedding pipelines.
* **Graph & Reasoning Data Models**: Experience with graph databases and relationship modelling for retrieval/reasoning use cases.
* **Agentic Workflows**: Built agentic/multi-agent workflows using an orchestration framework (ADK-style or equivalent); familiarity with agentic development frameworks.
* **DevOps / IaC / Security & Portability**: Terraform (IaC), CI/CD, containerisation and MLOps; strong IAM/networking/cloud security; experience building cloud-agnostic solutions using open-source components.

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Data Glossary-3Overview  
The Senior Analyst, Data Glossary is responsible for the glossary content creation within the enterprise data glossary for assigned data sets and domains. This includes curating the data to be included by ensuring the critical data elements are appropriately identified, categorizing and classifying data, applying business term naming and definition standards, facilitating the rationalization of business terms at an enterprise level across business units, and ensuring content is represented accurately within tooling. This individual will serve as a semantic subject matter expert for assigned data domains and/or data sets as Mastercard expands its data management program and strategy within the office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO).  
  
This role is within the Data Management & Strategy team, with reporting structure up to the Chief Data Officer.
  
  
Role  

* Coordinate and communicate with data subject matter experts and other stakeholders to curate and proof the content to be included in the data glossary for assigned data domains, ensuring business terms conform to standards.
* Normalize terms cross-functionally, ensuring no term duplicates, and facilitating consensus among competing stakeholders.
* Ensure content is loaded and maintained in enterprise tooling. Participate in the identification and implementation of controls to ensure glossary integrity.
* Collaborate closely with team members and cross-functional teams to ensure content and process alignment. Contribute to process automation and streamlining operational procedures.
* Assist in researching and evaluating external related standards.
* Align with established data categories and concepts that may be managed by other team members.
* Solicit and incorporate continuous feedback from communities of interest and other stakeholders to improve data semantic models while maintaining governance.
* Assist with the creation and maintenance of standards and best practices related to the data glossary, including business term naming and definition standards. Solicit and incorporate continuous feedback from the community and other stakeholders.
* Assist with the training of new data glossary resources.
* Coordinate with Operations & Technology support teams to report, track, and escalate any tool issues or defects impacting the performance or usability of the data glossary tools
* Serve as a data-driven change agent and advocate, persuading and influencing the organization at the grassroots level.

All About You  
  

* Excellent writing skills, including the ability to concisely and precisely convey information to the intended audience in an easy to understand, unambiguous manner.
* Advanced Excel skills are desirable, intermediate required at a minimum.
* Demonstrated experience in working with data.
* Demonstrated experience with the application of standards.
* Hands-on experience with projects involving an enterprise glossary, thesaurus, or controlled vocabulary.
* Highly-motivated self-starter with the ability to multi-task between strategy-related work and tactical ‘in the trenches’ work, while working under deadlines. Ability to produce effective business results while under time pressures.
* Ability to understand and analyze complex information products, systems and processes and to break down complex concepts into clear articulated information to aid organizational understanding and identify common themes.
* Any experience related to data management or data governance including working with data dictionaries, metadata management solutions, data models, data lineage, data quality, data and analytics solutions, data categorization, defining the properties and relationships of concepts, data classification, and data issue tracking is an advantage.
* Strong interpersonal communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
* Without direct authority, ability to motivate and influence others to achieve organization goals.
* Experience in the technology and/or finance industries is helpful.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Oracle Fusion ITGC Analyst
description:
:

**Oracle Fusion ITGC Analyst**

Support Oracle Fusion Financials and ITGC processes in a global enterprise environment

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the CIS division-wide subject matter expert for IT General Controls, SOX compliance, technology controls, and PCAOB audit readiness.
* Develop and maintain consistent ITGC policies, standards, control procedures, documentation, and evidence requirements across in-scope CIS applications and technologies.
* Partner with application owners, administrators, developers, infrastructure teams, Finance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to incorporate compliance by design into systems, integrations, changes, and operational processes.
* Configure and administer Fastpath GRC for User Access Reviews, segregation-of-duties monitoring, access-risk analysis, mitigating controls, audit-log reviews, and compliance reporting.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews and monitor privileged access, service accounts, segregation-of-duties conflicts, and joiner, mover, and leaver controls.
* Oversee controls for system development, change management, configuration changes, production migrations, computer operations, interfaces, batch processing, and audit logging.
* Conduct ITGC risk assessments, control walkthroughs, self-assessments, compliance reviews, and evaluations of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Identify control gaps, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate sustainable remediation of deficiencies and recurring exceptions.
* Act as the primary CIS liaison with internal and external auditors for ITGC walkthroughs, questionnaires, evidence requests, testing, findings, and remediation.
* Maintain an audit-ready documentation library, including control narratives, risk and control matrices, access reviews, change evidence, test results, SOC reports, bridge letters, and remediation records.
* Review third-party assurance reports and coordinate responses to exceptions, complementary user-entity controls, and other service-provider risks.

title: Associate Analyst, Analytics & Metrics
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Associate Analyst, Analytics & MetricsOverview  
We are seeking a Data Analyst to transform complex payments, transaction, customer, and operational data into accurate reporting and actionable business insights. The role combines hands-on data management, data quality, SQL and Python analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and stakeholder collaboration. The successful candidate will work with business and technology teams to improve performance, identify trends and growth opportunities, and support reliable, data-driven decisions.  
Role  
Data Preparation, Quality and Governance  

* Extract, compile, cleanse, validate, standardize, and organize large datasets from multiple internal and external sources using SQL, Python, Excel, and approved data platforms.
* Review data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, duplication, and compatibility; investigate discrepancies and correct issues where possible or escalate them through defined channels.
* Research and obtain missing information required to complete datasets, records, or supporting documentation.
* Apply defined data extraction, labelling, categorization, mapping, reconciliation, and quality-control procedures.
* Perform internal quality reviews and maintain clear evidence of checks, corrections, assumptions, and data lineage.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with professional maturity and comply with applicable data privacy, security, governance, and retention requirements.

Analysis and Business Insights  

* Analyze payments and transaction data to identify trends, anomalies, customer behavior, operational performance, and potential growth or efficiency opportunities.

Use descriptive statistics, trend analysis, segmentation, model testing, and root-cause analysis
  

* Translate business requirements into structured analytical approaches, datasets, metrics, and reporting solutions.
* Interpret findings with the end user in mind and provide clear, practical recommendations supported by data.
* Collaborate with business, operations, product, risk, and technology stakeholders to clarify requirements and validate analytical outputs.

SQL, Python, Databricks and Automation  

* Write and optimize SQL queries using joins, common table expressions, subqueries, aggregations, and window functions for extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Use Python, particularly pandas and NumPy, to manipulate data, perform quality checks, conduct analysis, and build reusable processing scripts.
* Work with Databricks notebooks and Spark or PySpark for data preparation and distributed processing, with guidance for more complex engineering activities.
* Automate recurring reports, validation routines, and data preparation processes to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Support basic machine-learning activities such as feature preparation, model testing, performance evaluation, classification, clustering, or predictive analysis under established frameworks.
* Document code, logic, dependencies, business rules, and operating procedures so solutions can be reviewed, maintained, and reused.

Reporting and Visualization  

* Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to track business metrics, KPIs, trends, and exceptions.
* Prepare accurate recurring and ad-hoc reports, presentations, and analytical summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Validate dashboard calculations and reporting outputs against source systems before release.
* Store completed work in designated repositories, maintain appropriate versions, and perform backup activities as instructed.
* Present findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and respond to follow-up questions with supporting evidence.

Delivery and Collaboration  

* Manage multiple assignments or projects simultaneously while meeting agreed quality, productivity, and turnaround expectations.
* Work effectively in a fast-paced environment, prioritize competing requests, and communicate risks or delays early.
* Partner with cross-functional and global teams, participate in reviews, and contribute to process and reporting improvements.
* Operate independently on defined tasks while seeking appropriate guidance for complex, ambiguous, or high-risk issues.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, punctuality, attention to detail, and a goal-oriented approach.

All About You  
Required Qualifications and Experience  

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Commerce, or a related discipline.

3-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data management, reporting, or a related technical role.  

* Proven experience working with large datasets, performing data validation, resolving quality issues, and delivering accurate analytical outputs.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, window functions, and complex queries.
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis, particularly pandas and NumPy.
* Good to have knowledge on Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable data-visualization platform.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and preferably Power Query.
* Working knowledge of statistics, trend analysis, model testing, and analytical problem-solving.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, presentations, and stakeholder discussions.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work accurately within deadlines.
* Experience with web-based applications, internet research, Microsoft Office, and common data-management tools.

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience in payments, banking, fintech, financial services, or another transaction-intensive environment.
* Familiarity with payment and transaction metrics, customer segmentation, fraud or anomaly analytics, and operational performance reporting.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, PySpark, cloud data platforms, Delta tables, or distributed data-processing concepts.
* Exposure to machine-learning modelling, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, and interpretation of results.
* Experience with APIs, Git or version control, reporting automation, A/B testing, or predictive analytics.
* Relevant certifications in analytics, business intelligence, cloud platforms, Python, SQL, or Databricks are advantageous.
* Flexibility to support India night shifts, a 24x7 operating model, or alignment with the US holiday calendar where required by the team.

Success in This Role  

* Deliver accurate, complete, and timely analyses, reports, and datasets with clear quality checks.
* Create dashboards and visualizations that are easy to understand, relevant to end users, and aligned with agreed business metrics.
* Reduce manual reporting and data-preparation effort through practical, maintainable automation.
* Identify meaningful trends, discrepancies, risks, and opportunities and convert them into actionable recommendations.
* Build stakeholder confidence through reliable delivery, transparent communication, sound documentation, and responsible handling of data.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Global Digital Transformation initiative at General Mills in capacity of a D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship. This role will report into Sr. D&T Manager - Data Stewardship, GDGS team in India and functionally collaborate with stakeholders across the Enterprise teams. It is an Individual contributor role. We are seeking a detail-oriented and forward-thinking Data Steward to support the development and governance of data powering **agentic AI systems** —AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making and task execution. This role ensures data quality, integrity, compliance, and usability across the lifecycle of intelligent agents. This role will work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product teams, and governance stakeholders to maintain trustworthy, well-structured, and ethically managed datasets that drive reliable agent behaviour.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Define and implement data quality rules (schema validation, referential integrity, distribution checks, drift detection) using Data Quality tools.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to define and monitor data quality metrics (accuracy, completeness, consistency) essential for high-performing, unbiased AI agents and their tools.
* Monitor dataset health metrics (null ratios, entropy, cardinality, outliers) and set up alerting mechanisms.
* Implement end-to-end **data lineage** across ingestion transformation feature stores model inputs agent outputs.
* Use observability tools (Monte Carlo, etc) to trace data dependencies impacting agent decisions
* Support root cause analysis of agent failures linked to upstream data issues.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Legal/Compliance, and Business Process Owners regarding all data-related aspects of Agentic AI solutions.
* Maintain **data catalogs and semantic layers** (Collibra, Alation, etc)
* Ensure interoperability across structured data and unstructured data.
* Ensure all data practices related to Agentic AI comply with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), paying close attention to the unique compliance risks of autonomous data use
* Establish and enforce data governance policies, standards, and procedures uniquely tailored for AI agents, including data collection, usage, sharing, and retention protocols specific to autonomous and multi-agent systems.
* Enforce **data access controls** , masking, and PII handling in accordance with regulations.
* Maintain audit trails for data used in agent decisions (critical for explainability and compliance).
* Develop and execute procedures for Annual Attestation for Unstructured Data Management Plans (DMP) and Agentic AI Data Management Plans (ADMPs)
* Support DMP/ADMP automation initiatives across BQ, Agentic AI, and other applicable areas of data governance
Establish audit compliance methodology and communication processes (e.g., all data sources/agents have DMP/ADMP, cataloguing of all AI agents, attestation completion)  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  
Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of total experience  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python for data processing
* Experience with Data Modeling, schema design and data validation frameworks.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Data Governance strategies and processes
* Experience with Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Data Observability, Data versioning, End to End Process mindset, Lineage.
* Exposure to Database Technologies (GCP, Cloud, etc)
* Exposure to Agile Methodologies (ADO, etc)
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change within their domain
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience and competence in leading, influencing, coaching and mentoring others
* Attention to detail with the ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: SAP Business Analyst
description:
**POSITION PURPOSE**

The Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment is the functional owner of the Enterprise order fulfillment solutions within the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization. The role translates validated business requirements into working, supported application functionality (mainly, but not limited to, SAP) across the order fulfillment landscape - covering Sales & Distribution (SD) order management, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Logistics Execution, delivery and shipping, and billing - and is accountable for the quality, consistency, and supportability of that functionality.

The role sits within the global Enterprise Business Analysis team and is aligned to the Order Fulfillment functional domain. It partners with the Order Fulfillment Global Functional Lead and the Business Enablement & Adoption organization, who own business process design, business requirements definition, and adoption. This role owns everything from functional specification onward: configuration, development coordination, testing, cutover, and ongoing application support.

The successful candidate combines genuine SAP order management and logistics execution configuration depth with the ability to work directly with customer service, order management, and logistics stakeholders, and applies the change management, documentation, and control standards that govern the application estate.

**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Functional Design & Specification**

* Translate validated business requirements received from the Order Fulfillment Global Functional Lead and the Business Enablement & Adoption team into functional specifications, solution designs, and configuration approaches for the SAP order fulfillment landscape.
* Advise business partners and IT colleagues on standard SAP capability and leading practice for Sales & Distribution (SD) order management, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Logistics Execution, delivery and shipping, and billing, actively steering solutions toward fit-to-standard adoption over custom development.
* Assess the functional and integration impact of proposed changes across adjacent domains, including Customer Experience and Sales, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Purchasing, and Finance (accounts receivable and revenue recognition).
* Provide functional input to application rationalization and integration assessments for order fulfillment systems, supporting - but not owning - the architecture decisions held by Integration & Solutions Architecture.

**Configuration & Solution Delivery**

* Own SAP configuration for the order fulfillment modules, ensuring changes are designed, documented, and delivered to the standards set by the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization.
* Partner with the technical lead and the application development team to define, deliver, and validate custom development where standard functionality cannot meet a validated requirement.
* Deliver configuration and development activities with attention to quality, consistency, reusability, and scalability across regions and entities.
* Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, functional design documents, and technical handover material.

**Testing, Cutover & Release**

* Own functional and integration testing for the order fulfillment workstream, including test script preparation, execution, defect logging, and retest.
* Support business-led user acceptance testing by preparing test environments and data, resolving defects, and providing functional guidance to business testers.
* Plan and execute cutover activities for order fulfillment scope, including data validation, sequencing, and hyper care, with attention to open order and in-transit delivery continuity.
* Comply with application change management and transport procedures, ensuring appropriate approval and evidence of control operation for audit purposes.

**Application Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as the functional escalation point for order fulfillment related incidents and defects, driving timely investigation, root cause analysis, and remediation within agreed service levels.
* Identify and deliver continuous improvement opportunities that optimize SAP order fulfillment processes, improve system performance, and reduce recurring incident volume.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators relating to order fulfillment solution quality, defect trends, and change delivery, using data to inform prioritization.
* Contribute to the reduction of technical debt and custom-code footprint within the order fulfillment landscape.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer**

* Collaborate with Business Analysts in adjacent functional domains to ensure end-to-end process integrity across the Enterprise System landscape, with particular attention to the customer-facing and finance touchpoints of the order-to-cash chain.
* Maintain strong working relationships with customer service, order management, logistics and distribution stakeholders, regional business teams, and external implementation partners.
* Create and maintain configuration guides and functional documentation and provide functional content and subject-matter input to training materials owned by the Business Enablement & Adoption team.
* Provide functional guidance and knowledge transfer to application support colleagues, third-party partners, and less experienced analysts.

**NATURE AND SCOPE**

The Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment reports to the Global Manager, Enterprise Business Analysis within the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization. There are no direct reports to this position. The role exercises significant functional influence over the order fulfillment solution and coordinates the work of technical colleagues and external partners on order fulfillment scope.

The role operates globally across all BAC entities and works within the application architecture, change management, and quality standards owned by the Digital Applications & Product Delivery organization. As order fulfillment sits between the customer-facing and financial ends of the order-to-cash chain, the position carries meaningful cross-functional visibility with customer service, logistics, and finance stakeholders.

**PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Quality and timeliness of functional specifications and configuration delivery against agreed commitments.
* Defect escape rate from functional testing into user acceptance testing and production.
* Incident resolution performance for order fulfillment related issues against agreed service levels, including during period-end and peak shipping windows.
* Proportion of requirements met through standard SAP capability versus custom development.
* Completeness and currency of configuration and functional documentation.
* Stakeholder satisfaction from customer service, order management, logistics, and regional business teams.

No grants of authority have been assigned to the Business Analyst – Order Fulfillment.

The Business Analyst - Order Fulfillment maintains regular contact with the Enterprise Business Analysis and Application Development teams; Integration & Solutions Architecture; Application support colleagues; the Order Fulfillment Global Functional Lead and the Business Enablement & Adoption team; Customer Service, Order Management, Logistics and regional business stakeholders; and third-party SAP consultants and implementation partners.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in information technology, computer science, supply chain, business, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in SAP configuration, functional analysis, or closely related roles, preferably in a global environment.
* Proven configuration expertise in Sales & Distribution (SD) order management, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Logistics Execution, delivery and shipping, and billing.
* Familiarity with adjacent integration points, particularly Customer Experience and Sales, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Purchasing, and Finance, and with transportation and warehouse management systems.
* Strong understanding of order fulfillment business processes and how they are enabled by SAP solutions.
* Working knowledge of application change management and transport procedures, and of the control and audit requirements that apply to system changes, including segregation of duties in an order management context.
* Experience partnering with technical developers to specify, deliver, and validate custom development.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both customer service and logistics personnel and technical colleagues.
* A pro-active, solution-oriented mindset with a strong sense of urgency and customer focus.

**Preferred**

* SAP certification in Sales & Distribution or Logistics Execution.
* Experience of an S/4HANA implementation or migration program, including advanced ATP.
* Experience in an engineer-to-order or highly configurable product environment.
* Exposure to transportation management, warehouse management, EDI, and customer portal integrations.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk up to 50% of the time. description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Business Analysis

In this role, you will:

**Key responsibilities**

The Avaloq Technical Business Analyst will:

* Work with stakeholders to understand business goals, processes, scope, users, controls, and expected outcomes.
* Analyse requirements and translate them into clear Avaloq functional and technical requirements.
* Document current and future processes, business rules, data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, and operational impacts.
* Identify gaps between business needs and existing Avaloq functionality.
* Assess the impact of changes on Avaloq modules, configuration, customisation, integrations, data, reports, controls, and support processes.
* Recommend practical solutions that follow Avaloq standards and HSBC technology, risk, and control requirements.
* Work with solution architects and technical teams to define interfaces, data mappings, dependencies, and non-functional requirements.
* Support Avaloq configuration, customisation, workflow, and integration design.
* Produce functional specifications, technical requirement documents, process models, interface specifications, data mappings, and acceptance criteria.
* Support estimation by identifying scope, dependencies, delivery risks, and likely configuration, development, migration, and testing effort.
* Clarify requirements for developers, Avaloq specialists, testers, and vendors during delivery.
* Define test scenarios and expected results for functional, integration, regression, migration, and user acceptance testing.
* Analyse defects and production issues across Avaloq processes, configuration, custom code, interfaces, data, and connected systems.
* Support migration analysis, including data mapping, data quality rules, reconciliation, and migration validation.
* Assess the impact of regulatory, policy, and control changes on Avaloq processes and data.
* Work with Avaloq vendors and internal teams on enhancements, defects, releases, upgrades, and technical dependencies.
* Maintain traceability from the original requirement through design, implementation, testing, approval, and release.
* Communicate decisions, risks, dependencies, progress, and open issues clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Help prioritise competing requirements and make practical recommendations when scope, timelines, or technical constraints conflict

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

**Role profile**

The Avaloq Technical Business Analyst supports Avaloq change and delivery activities across HSBC locations and different system landscapes.

The role requires strong knowledge of the Avaloq Banking Suite, combined with the ability to understand banking processes and explain technical impacts. The successful candidate can challenge unclear requirements, identify dependencies, document complex processes, and help delivery teams reach a safe and workable outcome.

**Qualifications and experience**

* 10+ Yrs of overall experience in technology and 5+ Yrs in executing projects using Avaloq skillset
* Strong hands-on experience with the Avaloq Banking Suite.
* Experience analysing Avaloq requirements for implementation, configuration, customisation, migration, upgrades, and integration.
* Practical understanding of Avaloq processes, product setup, workflows, data structures, interfaces, batch processing, and downstream systems.
* Experience taking Avaloq change requests from initial analysis through development, testing, implementation, and post-release support.
* Experience writing Avaloq functional specifications, technical requirements, interface definitions, data mappings, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience assessing the impact of Avaloq changes across connected systems, reporting, operations, controls, and regulatory processes.
* Experience working on major Avaloq implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation programmes.
* Experience working with Avaloq vendors and understanding vendor standards, release processes, product constraints, and technical dependencies.
* Experience supporting functional, integration, regression, migration, and user acceptance testing for Avaloq solutions.
* Experience analysing defects and incidents involving Avaloq configuration, custom code, interfaces, data, or business processes.
* Experience with data migration, reconciliation, data quality, and migration validation in an Avaloq environment.
* Knowledge of transactional banking, securities, OTC trading, finance, lombard lending, and Private Bank products is an advantage.
* Understanding of banking controls, operational risk, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
* Ability to work with stakeholders across several banking domains.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business users, product owners, developers, testers, architects, vendors, and control functions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis and downstream impact assessment.
* Strong documentation and workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to prioritise changing requirements and make pragmatic decisions.
* Ability to explain complex Avaloq, banking, data, and integration topics clearly in writing and verbally.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Sales Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

Job Purpose: Serve as a key business analyst supporting the design and delivery of global sales systems and processes. This role is accountable for translating business needs into detailed system requirements, epics, user stories, and use cases. The analyst will work closely with Sales, IT, and cross-functional teams to ensure that platform enhancements and new capabilities are well-defined, prioritised, and aligned to business goals.

Principal Accountabilities

* Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable system requirements.
* Process Design & Documentation: Map current and future state sales processes, identifying gaps and opportunities for simplification and automation.
* User Stories & Epics: Write high-quality epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support Agile delivery, ensuring traceability from business need to technical implementation.
* Use Case Development: Create detailed use cases and process flows to support solution design and user experience improvements.
* Backlog Management: Partner with Product Owners and IT to manage the backlog, prioritise features, and support sprint planning and refinement sessions.
* Testing & Validation: Support UAT planning and execution, ensuring that delivered functionality meets business requirements and is fit for purpose.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring alignment and shared understanding throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Measures of Success

* High-quality, complete, and timely documentation of business requirements and user stories
* Strong alignment between business needs and delivered system capabilities
* Improved process efficiency and user satisfaction with sales platforms
* Reduced rework and change requests due to clear and validated requirements
* Effective collaboration across business and technical teams
