title: Consultant - Advanced Analytics, GIC SC Analytics
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

  

Supply chain analytics group is responsible for delivering the solutions and developing the capabilities which enables better decision-making in supply chain This role is in the Segment analytics team that supports the Segment teams by developing advanced analytics solutions to identify and analyze opportunities corresponding to variety of SC Analytics problem statements. The primary responsibilities of this job are to develop innovative solutions by leveraging analytics techniques like descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive modeling, statistical analysis and operations research techniques. This is an individual contributor role that includes project lead responsibilities, stakeholder management, project management, coaching and mentoring the analysts in the team. This role requires to operate in 1.30pm to 10.30 pm shift.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

**Requirement Gathering and Project Management (20% of Time)**

* Partner with supply chain stakeholders to understand business decisions, operational context, constraints, and desired outcomes, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical problems, hypotheses, scope, and success measures.
* Select the right approach—statistical analysis, machine learning, forecasting, experimentation, or operations research—while assessing data readiness, risks, dependencies, feasibility, priorities, and milestones.

**Analytics Models design, development & Improve (40% of Time)**

* Ideate and execute improvements that drive efficiency, standardization, and scalable solutions through historical data analysis and machine learning.
* Develop analytical models across descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics, including feature engineering and automated testing.
* Explain and deploy model recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders while supporting enhancements and bug fixes for existing models.

**Output (20% of Time)**

* Provide actionable insights through effective presentations and visualizations while deploying, documenting, and sustaining models and applications using DevOps/MLOps practices.

**Training / Knowledge (20% of Time)**

* Mentor and train team members in data preparation, diagnostics, predictive analytics, R, Python, and supply chain analytics.
Standardization and document processes, working on individual development plans, and contribute to data science processes, frameworks, tools, and standards.  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* **Education:** Full-Time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory).
* **Experience:** At least 4 years of relevant experience in analytics, data science, machine learning, or a closely related field.
* **Technical Skills:** Experience in descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics; proficiency in R, Python, intermediate SQL, Excel, and Power BI; and a strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain operations.
* **Soft Skills:** Lead and develop analytical capabilities with strong problem-solving, learning agility, and independent decision-making.
* Engage stakeholders and lead projects collaboratively, applying strong project management and organizational skills.
Explain analytical findings, assumptions, model behavior, and limitations clearly while energizing teams and supporting cross-functional collaboration.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Master’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience in Operations Research, Analytics, Mechanical, Industrial or Production Engineering, or Statistics.

* Experience working on DevOps/MLOps, Git & GCP.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
Job Description

**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**What should you know about us?**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

The Senior Customer Success Data Analyst owns how Customer Success uses data to improve adoption, retention, drive expansion and decide where CSMs focus.

You will own the CS analytics strategy, metric framework, customer health score and churn-prediction approach, and act as the analytics partner to the Head of CS Operations and CS leadership. As the team is new, you will design how data from various platforms, databases and raw Excel dumps in Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk and product telemetry comes together, and set the standard for how we use analytics and AI across Customer Success.

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

**CS analytics strategy**

* Own the CS analytics roadmap with the Head of CS Operations, prioritizing work by impact on retention and growth.
* Act as the trusted analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping decisions on segmentation, coverage models and customer playbooks.
* Present insights to CS leadership and contribute to board-level reporting.

**Customer health and churn prediction**

* Own the customer health score methodology end to end — design, validation against actual renewal and churn outcomes, and regular recalibration.
* Build predictive churn and propensity models (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis) and turn them into early-warning signals CSMs can act on.
* Compare retention and outcomes across customer groups (industry, region, account segments, products, sign-up period) to uncover what drives churn and growth.
* Lead root-cause analysis of churn and downsell.

**Metrics, dashboards and reporting**

* Define and govern the CS metric framework and a single source of truth so CS, Sales, Finance and Product report the same numbers and details.
* Own reporting on core CS KRAs — Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR/NRR), other renewal and growth details, time-to-value, adoption and health distribution.
* Oversee dashboards in Excel, presentations and Power BI for CS leadership and CSMs.
* Lead data and meeting preparation for internal monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and leadership/board reporting.

**Product usage, renewals and expansion**

* Partner with Product and Engineering to model product telemetry for adoption and value-realization metrics.
* Own risk-weighted renewal forecasting, so leadership sees a realistic outlook and CSMs know which renewals need attention.
* Analyze feature adoption, usage depth and breadth, and onboarding milestones to identify at-risk and high-potential accounts.
* Build models that identify upsell and cross-sell signals from usage, license utilization, account health and intelligence, and share them with CSMs.
* Measure the impact of CS programs and plays on retention and expansion revenue.

**Data foundations**

* Set data-quality and governance standards for CRM and CS-platform data, and drive fixes with system owners
* Design the CS data model and integrations across Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk, internal deployment tools and product data.
* Document metrics, data sources and processes so analytics can scale with the team.

**AI-enabled analytics**

* Use LLMs such as Claude hands-on to accelerate building modules, analysis of data, querying data, documentation and insight generation.
* Design and roll out AI-assisted workflows and agents for CS — e.g. account summaries, sentiment analysis, renewal-risk briefs etc.
* Set guidelines for responsible, secure use of AI with customer data, in line with Seclore's data-protection standards.

**Your first 90 days:**

First 30 days

* Understand our customers, products and CS motion; assess data sources across various tools like Salesforce, Statisfy, product telemetry etc.
* Deliver a gap assessment of data quality.
* Deliver a baseline view of retention and renewals.

By 60 days

* Get the CS metric definition and framework agreed across CS and Finance.
* Launch the first version of CS leadership dashboard.
* Present the health-score framework and churn-model design.

By 90 days

* Launch V1 of the health score.
* Deliver a risk-weighted renewal forecast framework to CSMs for regular use.
* Publish a prioritized CS analytics roadmap.

**How we will measure impact over time:** Predictive accuracy of the health score and churn models, use of insights in leadership and CSM decisions, data-quality improvements in CRM/CS platforms, and measurable contribution to GRR, NRR and adoption.

**What you bring**

* 5–7 years of experience in data analytics, with at least 2–3 years in customer success, revenue or business operations analytics, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; a master's degree is a plus.
* Proven track record of building customer health scores or churn models end to end and getting them adopted by CS teams.
* Advanced SQL and strong Python for data wrangling, statistical analysis and predictive modeling (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis).
* Expert-level dashboard building in Power BI and Excel.
* Deep experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) data — accounts, opportunities, renewals.
* Hands-on experience administering or configuring a customer success platform such as Statisfy, Gainsight, Totango or ChurnZero.
* Experience designing data models and working with data from multiple systems and raw sources.
* Strong command of SaaS and subscription metrics: ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, renewal rate, adoption.
* Advanced, hands-on AI user with experience applying LLMs such as Claude to analysis, coding, automation and documentation.
* A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving decisions with data and clear storytelling.
* A builder mindset and comfort creating structure, standards and processes where none exist yet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in cybersecurity, data security or another enterprise B2B technology domain.
* Experience leading small analytics projects or teams.
* Experience helping build a CS Ops function from scratch.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience building AI agents or automated workflows for business teams.
* Exposure to customer segmentation and CS coverage-model design.

**Who you will work with:**

You will work closely with CSMs, Solution Consultants, Project Managers, Technical Consultants, and Sales to monitor account health, identify risks, generate renewal and expansion insights, support renewal forecasting, manage expansion pipelines, and maintain shared CRM data standards. You will partner with Product and Engineering to leverage usage telemetry, drive adoption insights, and establish product feedback loops. You will also collaborate with Finance and Leadership on ARR, GRR, NRR, and retention reporting for business and board reviews.

**Why join us**

* Be the senior analytics voice in a new CS Operations team and shape how Customer Success uses data.
* High visibility, with direct exposure to CS, Sales, Product and Finance leadership decisions.
* Work on meaningful problems for global enterprise customers in data security.
* Hands-on use of modern analytics and AI tools, with room to experiment.

**How to apply**

Complete the Microsoft Form.

After submitting the form, continue and submit your application on our **Careers page**.

title: Sr Business Analyst (Pharmacovigilance & AI Systems)
description:
**Company Description**

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Requirements Engineering**

* Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
* Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
* Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
* Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
* Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

**Domain coverage**

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

* Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
* Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
* Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
* Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
* Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
* PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

**Agentic AI specifics**

* Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
* Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
* Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
* Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
* Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

**Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance**

* Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
  + 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
  + GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
  + GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
  + Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
  + Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  + Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.
* Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

**Stakeholder and delivery**

* Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
* Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
* Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
* Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

  
**Qualifications**

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
* 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
* Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
* Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
* Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
* Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
* Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.
* Comfortable with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

**Preferred**

* Experience with E2B(R3) implementation, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, and EudraVigilance or FAERS data.
* Experience specifying NLP, machine-learning or GenAI features (classification, extraction, summarisation) including evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria.
* Familiarity with GAMP 5 second edition and the FDA Computer Software Assurance approach.
* Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.
* Prior participation in regulatory inspections or client audits of PV systems.
* Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or ISPE/GAMP training.

  
**Additional Information**

**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**

**Patient Minded** I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.  
**Client Delight** I own every client experience and its impact on results.  
**Take Action** I am empowered and empower others to act now.  
**Grow Talent** I own my development and invest in the development of others.  
**Win Together** I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.  
**Communication Matters** I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.  
**Embrace Diversity** I create an environment of awareness and respect.  
**Always Innovate** I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. We believe in the power of **diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning** , and strive to ensure our people reflect the customers we proudly serve. With a workforce of over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade.


**Join us** as we leverage cutting\-edge technologies and create global opportunities. Let’s sail together towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.


**Purpose of the role**  



This role is responsible for managing and maintaining master data for 70\+ APM Terminals globally, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with defined standards. The individual will create, validate, and update master data records, perform quality checks, and resolve data inconsistencies or duplicates. The role involves handling requests from global stakeholders, supporting data governance initiatives, and maintaining high data quality. Candidates should be comfortable working with large datasets using Excel and basic SQL for analysis and reporting. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication are essential for success in this role.  



  

**You will be responsible for:**

* Validate, and update master data requests, ensuring adherence to data quality rules and country\-specific exceptions.
* Conduct periodic quality checks on master data to maintain accuracy and consistency.
* Update vendor and customer master data in alignment with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and data guidelines.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve duplicate records within the master data system.
* Collaborate with Data Steward and Governance teams to support data quality initiatives and clean\-up activities.
* Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for master data processes.
* Participate in discussions with Business Partners and Stakeholders, addressing ad\-hoc requirements with urgency and professionalism.
* Utilize SQL queries to extract and analyze data for quality checks and reporting purposes.
* Create and maintain Power BI dashboards to monitor and report on data quality.
* Support audit requirements and ensure compliance with master data guidelines.
* Continuously improve data management processes by identifying areas for enhancement.

**Requirements:**

* Proven experience in Master Data Management (MDM) or a related field.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
* Strong communication skills for effective stakeholder interaction.
* Attention to detail with a proactive approach to resolving data issues.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work effectively.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate of any bachelor's degree.
* Fluent in English with good communication skills.

**What We Offer:**

* **Impact** : Be part of a team that directly contributes to global operations.
* **Opportunity** : Unlock professional and personal growth through diverse career pathways.
* **Innovation** : Work with a team that embraces technology and continuous improvement.
* **Global Exposure** : Collaborate across geographies and cultures.
* **Work\-Life Balance** : Flexible working arrangements to support your well\-being

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst, SAP IBP Planning
description:
For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU \- the engine of modern visual computing \- the field has expanded to encompass personal computer games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, visual computing is becoming increasingly central to how people harmonize with technology, and there has never been a more exciting time to join our excellent team. NVIDIA is now passionate about innovation at the intersection of visual processing, high performance computing, and artificial intelligence.


The Supply Chain Information Technology team has opening for a Senior Business Systems Analyst, SAP IBP Planning. The role is responsible for developing advanced planning solutions, data analysis, optimization models for strategic and tactical Supply chain planning and supporting the existing SAP IBP / APO Planning Solutions. The opportunity is for Nvidia headquarters located in Santa Clara, California. Strong knowledge of supply chain business processes and experience working collaboratively with business counterparts is a must.

**What** **you’ll** **be** **doing:**

* Architect, design and deliver robust implementable solutions for complex supply chain requirements using SAP IBP Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Optimization and Fulfillment Techniques involving SAP IBP utilizing both order\-series and time\-series planning.
* Demonstrate process improvement techniques to streamline business process and architect solutions.
* Lead projects to implement new and improved existing functionalities that are already implemented at NVIDIA in IBP.
* Build prototypes and proof of concepts for business requirements and translate them into effective operational solutions.
* Apply industry\-best practices for data analysis and share across the teams.
* Build business and product scenarios to help the BU improve NVIDIA's profitability and market share.
* Perform testing to support system implementations and upgrades, and drive system design analysis, testing, and training
* Collaborate with cross functional teams in business and IT to deliver comprehensive supply chain planning solutions, and Influence senior leadership in business to adopt scalable solutions and systems/tools.

**What** **we** **need** **to** **see:**

* Bachelors or Master's degree, or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, or Business.
* 12\+ plus years of relevant work experience architecting, designing and implementing comprehensive supply chain planning solutions using advanced planning tools.
* Envision and architect scalable supply planning solution(s) to meet needs of growing business.
* Data integration and automation expertise in SAAS planning tools is a plus.
* Good hands\-on experience with SAP IBP Supply response, SAP IBP optimization, and modeling for solving Supply Chain problems relevant in semiconductor industry.
* The ideal candidate should have good understanding of RTI and CI\-DS interfaces with SAP IBP.
* Good record of accomplishment using analysis to deliver business results.
* Self\-motivated and able to function effectively when working independently or in a team.
* Self\-starter who can take charge of complex tasks with minimal direction.
* Ability to debug and support applications developed in SAP IBP

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Knowledge of Kinaxis, Blue Yonder supply chain planning solutions
* Semiconductor industry supply chain planning knowledge and experience


NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

* Support strategic projects to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
* Support Xactly Administrators and Analytics teams to resolve challenges for the business to operative effectively

* Support the broader Xactly COE in driving value to the organization, including key partnerships with the COE Analytics, Administration and Change Management \& Governance teams, as well as peers in the Xactly development team
* Assess, configure, and deploy commission/incentive plans, workflows and custom apps (in Xactly Extend)

**Skills \& Experiences:**

* 2\+ years in Sales Comp related responsibilities with knowledge of Xactly modules
* Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, or a related field
* Xactly Administrator and Plan Configuration Certification(s), or ability to obtain after onboarding
* Proven experience in sales compensation administration, governance, and/or technical design, with an understanding of compensation methodologies and functional best practices.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to generate insightful analytics from complex data
* Strong interpersonal skills, capable of building relationships across various teams.
* Experience managing and/or dispositioning incentive compensation related disputes \& inquiries; or ability to interpret challenges from the sales organization and synthesize challenges while considering policies and processes.
* Ability to identify root causes of common disputes/inquiries or other related challenges, then recommending/delivering process/policy/technology changes that strengthen operational excellence.
* Proven experience calculating commissions and generating payroll submission files.
* Ability to think strategically while considering tactical implications.
* Strong Hands on with PowerPoint and Excel

* Certifications from other ICM systems (i.e. Varicent, SAP\-Callidus)
* Sales Operation/Sales Admin experience across industry

---------------------------

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join the dynamic Workforce Planning organization, highlighting the chance to deliver quantitatively driven solutions and contribute to a team that supports various functions. The Workforce Planning (WFP) organization it is a part of Consumer and Community (CCB) Operations division. The Workforce Planning (WFP) Data Science organization is tasked with delivering quantitatively driven solutions to support the core WFP functions (demand forecasting, capacity planning, resource scheduling, and business analysis \& support).


As a Time Series Demand Forecasting Associate in Workforce Planning, you will be responsible for forecasting contact center demand at the daily and monthly time interval out to several years to assist with resource planning across CCB operations. The role is focused on time\-series forecasting, inferential statistics, data analysis and consulting with stakeholders to understand and explain our dynamic business.


The role applies operational analytics and strategy tools to enhance the integrated planning process, identify enhancements to the overall the forecasting process while supporting the development of analytical tools. The goal is to provide business insights needed in ensuring that forecasts are appropriately planned and in line with expectations so that our contact center network is optimally staffed, service goals are being met, and budgets are appropriately planned.


**Job responsibilities:**


* Identify opportunities to enhance existing call volume and productivity forecasting process.
* Monitor, Evaluate, and Improve Forecast Accuracy: Regularly assess the accuracy of forecasts by comparing them with actual outcomes, implement improvements based on findings, and use common sense approaches to explain changes and reasons for error.
* Possess strong interpersonal skills for partnering with various levels of the organization and influencing results.
* Provide analytical leadership to cross\-functional team structure that prepares detailed integrated forecasts across multiple lines of business, and segments.
* Take complex results and communicating them in an easily understood way, focusing on how specific results fit into the bigger picture.
* Explore opportunities for creating frameworks for automation using Python.
* Stay Informed on Industry Trends: Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in forecasting to ensure the organization remains competitive and innovative in its approach.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**


* Applied knowledge of 3\+ years' experience in business planning and processes: significant forecasting experience, and strong modeling background required. Strong analytical, interpretive, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret large amounts of data.
* Educational Background: MS/PHD Degree in quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics, Applied Math, Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering
* Hands on experience delivering descriptive statistics, inference, and visualizations to communicate with partners and stakeholders.
* Quantitative Mindset: Strong operational analytic/strategy mindset to identify opportunities and solve them through data and business insights using advanced mathematical approaches. Strong analytical, interpretive, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret large amounts of data and its impact in both operational and financial areas.
* Data Analytics and Software Proficiency: Experience leveraging analytical and statistical tools such as time series, regression, and other forecasting techniques using Python, R, or SAS.
* Communication skills: Superior written and oral presentation / communication skills – the ability to convey complex information simply and clearly to senior leadership. Demonstrated understanding of business value drivers and aligning teams to achieve business objectives.
* Hands\-on experience and theoretical understanding of time\-series forecasting \& advanced statistics like Moving Average, Exponential Smoothing, Auto\-Regression and Regression.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:**


* Experience with big\-data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, SparkML, etc. \& familiarity with basic data table operations (SQL, Hive, etc.).
* Strong applied technical skills in Python are preferred, with a willingness to transition from SAS or R if necessary.
* Experience with Spark, Trifacta, HiveQL, Alteryx, and SAS

title: Sr Associate Customer Support Analyst (AI/ML Application Support)
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

About the Team
  

  

At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
**About the Role**

  

We are seeking a customer\-focused Senior Associate Support Analyst to drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and operational optimization across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high\-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, investigate cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, evaluate LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams to inform feature iteration and product optimizations. A key part of this role involves evaluating AI quality: reviewing chat histories and AI responses to spot mistakes, figure out why they happened, and turn those insights into simple improvements that make the AI clearer, smarter, and more reliable.


* Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Knowledge: Develop a foundational understanding of enterprise SaaS workflows (including Finance, HR, and Payroll) to assist in validating AI logic and verifying expected system behaviour.
* AI Concepts: Review AI chat logs and execution outputs to spot incorrect answers, hallucinations, or misunderstandings. Document findings and recurring patterns to support senior team members and engineering in refining prompt logic.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Utilize established troubleshooting playbooks, diagnostic dashboards, and monitoring tools to reproduce reported issues, gather relevant logs, and isolate basic software bugs.
* Technical Acumen: Run basic database queries (SQL), review application logs, and inspect API payloads to verify data flow, check system state, and assist with basic cloud workflow troubleshooting.
* Customer Advocacy: Monitor and respond to incoming support queues, maintain strict SLA commitments, and communicate clearly with users. Provide empathetic, plain\-language updates to customers while issues are being investigated.
* Incident \& Queue Management: Perform initial queue triage, classify issue severity, and route high\-impact (P1\) incidents to senior analysts or engineering teams using defined escalation pathways. Participate in weekend and holiday on\-call rotations with team support.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, customer success, IT operations, software administration, or a technical internship.
* Technical \& System Operations:



	+ Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience using public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience accessing and reviewing system logs or monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, or cloud\-native log viewers).
* AI/LLM Familiarity: Experience using, testing, or reviewing Large Language Model (LLM) outputs or prompt structures.
* Queue Management: Minimum 1 year of experience managing ticketing systems, support queues, or prioritized task workflows.

  

**Other Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, Management Information Systems (MIS), Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical work experience in software support or system administration).
* Demonstrated interest in evaluating conversational AI performance, quality metrics, and output accuracy.
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts through written and verbal communication.
* Strong organizational skills and adaptability to learn complex, evolving technical systems.

title: Senior Analyst, Risk Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Analyst, Risk Management
Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management – Individual Contributor  

  

Overview  

  

The Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management, will support our SOX Compliance program within the Finance Organization and will report into the US\-based Manager, Risk Management. This position will primarily focus on scoping and evaluation of general and application IT controls. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for managing and executing various aspects of the program including IT scoping, delivery of the program, and reporting of results. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the US\-based SOX team, worldwide IT departments, regional controllership, our shared services center, business owners, and our internal and external auditors, with the expectation of some overlap in the working hours.  

  

Requirements for this position include extensive knowledge of IT general and application controls, strong understanding of IT control frameworks (e.g., COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS/SANS Top 20\), familiarity with SEC/PCAOB regulations, COSO and US GAAP, as well as the demonstrated ability to monitor an effective global risk\-based IT control environment.  

  

* Are you looking to join a fast\-paced, collaborative environment supporting a world class growing organization?
* Do you have the ability to think strategically and execute a complex project?
* Do you have a risk\-based mindset?
* Are you IT savvy?
* Do you have the ability to drive change and improve awareness across the organization?

  

Role  

  

Job Description  

* Support the execution of various SOX program components, including IT scoping, IT risk assessment, training of stakeholders on IT control\-related best practices, IT control testing and review, remediation recommendations, deficiency evaluations and reporting
* Report to a US\-based Manager, Risk Management
* Assess and determine design effectiveness of internal controls
* Experience covering multiple technology environments such as Mainframe, UNIX/Linux, Cloud and Windows environments
* Work with business owners to address any potential control gaps that may require remediation
* Partner with various business owners and IT teams including technology compliance, operations, development, and application support to provide expertise in assessing the design and effectiveness of IT controls
* Liaise with regional finance and IT stakeholders as well as internal and external auditors
* Ensure the delivery of high quality, timely work products
* Continuously identify efficiencies in the SOX program and opportunities for optimization of the financial and operational processes and controls through interaction and partnership with management
* Exhibit strong project management skills with the ability to hold self and others accountable to internal and external deadlines
* Ability to effectively manage international time\-zone differences in communication globally
* Demonstrate the ability to exercise judgment and display a high standard of ethics and professionalism
* Demonstrate exceptional communications skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to understand complexities of the business

  

All About You  

* Bachelor Degree Accounting, Business, Management Information Systems or equivalent, a CPA/CA, CISA or similar certification required
* Has a strong understanding of IT control concepts and framework such as COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS/SANS Top 20, Sarbanes Oxley, COSO, and leading business practices
* Recent experience providing IT auditing or IT advisory\-type services
* Knowledge of best practices around IT controls
* Working knowledge of current PCAOB Auditing and Accounting Standards
* Experience with the IT external audit or risk advisory services or an in\-house Technology Risk Management (first/second line of defense) or equivalent experience in a large, regulated organization with exposure to both infrastructure and applications
* Knowledge of common enterprise and web application technologies
* Familiarity with audit automation preferred
* Proven ability to manage complex engagements or programs
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills with emphasis on building strong, longer\-term relationships worldwide across varying geographies and functions
* Detail oriented, self\-motivated with the ability to meet project deadlines and deliverables in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in risk management field (e.g., risk management, audit, compliance) desired
* Effective ability to influence, drive change and resolve conflicts
* Strong analytic, logical reasoning and problem\-solving skills
* Strong project management skills to lead and prioritize multiple projects
* Demonstrated ability to drive change and continuous improvement
* Some travel may be required in the future, up to 10% travel

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Credit Review Intermediate Analyst, Office (Hybrid)
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Credit Risk Review (CRR)**
==================================


**Credit Risk Review** (CRR) provides independent, objective, reliable, valued, and timely assurance to the Board of Directors, Risk Committees, the Citigroup Chief Risk Officer, the Citigroup Chief Credit Officer, senior management, and global regulators. CRR evaluates the effectiveness of credit and collateral risk management, assessing the ability of business units and independent Risk Management to identify, monitor, and mitigate current and emerging credit risks.


**Role Overview**
=================


As a key member of the **CRR Analytics Team**, you will provide critical data analytics and credit risk analyst support to Lead Reviewers. This role is instrumental in managing ongoing portfolio monitoring and credit reviews, identifying thematic risk trends, and evaluating emerging risks. You will collaborate closely with reviewers to assign portfolios, establish sample coverages, and participate actively in review activities, while also supporting broader data\-driven credit risk projects across the CRR group.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


* **Credit \& Exposure Assessment**: Evaluate the integrity and accuracy of credit analyses, exposure calculations, risk rating methodologies, and asset classifications for monitored and reviewed relationships to ensure alignment with institutional policies and standards.
* **Credit Assessment Documentation**: Partner with Lead Reviewers to draft comprehensive Credit Assessment Documents, integrating advanced credit and data analytics to quantify thematic risks or substantiate a portfolio's stable outlook ("good bill of health").
* **Assistant to the Lead Reviewer:** Serve as a strategic analytical partner to Lead Reviewers, translating qualitative observations and risk hypotheses into rigorous, data\-backed evidence. Maintain a deep understanding of credit policies and data structures to track the end\-to\-end credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting standards, limit utilization, covenant compliance, and workout/remediation processes.
* **AI \& Analytics Innovation**: Leverage advanced AI and machine learning tools to streamline data extraction, identify thematic trends across diverse portfolios, and proactively flag emerging risk indicators.
* **Stakeholder Communication**: Synthesize complex analytical findings and present clear, concise conclusions and recommendations to Lead Reviewers and senior risk management.
* **Reporting \& Regulatory Presentations:** Assist in preparing high\-quality presentations and reporting materials to support internal governance committees and regulatory examinations.

**Qualifications**
==================


* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of credit analysis or credit risk management experience within a global financial institution or banking environment.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Formal credit training or a deep understanding of financial accounting standards and credit analysis methodologies.
* **Corporate/FI Analysis:** Prior experience assessing the creditworthiness and financial strength of Corporates and Financial Institutions is highly advantageous.
* **Digital Literacy:** High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and a strong aptitude for adopting AI\-enabled productivity and data analytics tools in compliance with organizational policies. Knowledge of Python is highly advantageous.
* **Professional Attributes:** Proactive, self\-motivated, and collaborative team player with a strong desire to learn and the ability to execute independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* **Execution Skills:** Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple deliverables.
* **Communication:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex risk concepts clearly and concisely to various levels of management.

**Education**
=============


* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BSc) in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Finance) and/or professional certification (e.g., CFA, FRM, CPA) are a plus.

Risk Management

**Supplementary Tasks**

* Conduct market, sector, and portfolio research to support underwriting and investment decision\-making processes.
* Utilize AI\-enabled tools and data analysis techniques to enhance reporting, monitoring, and diligence workflows.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a high attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

title: Business Analyst - PA26AUTRQ3136
description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

**Business Analyst – Role Profile**

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Business Analyst works collaboratively across business and technology teams to analyse, design, and deliver process and system improvements. Operating within a hybrid transformation environment, the role plays a key part in defining requirements, optimising workflows, supporting intelligent automation initiatives, and ensuring high\-quality delivery through structured testing and stakeholder engagement.


The role supports strategic transformation programmes across the business, including operational re\-engineering, service enhancement, capacity creation, automation delivery, and the adoption of AI\-powered solutions across the full trading and operational lifecycle.


In addition to supporting AI and automation initiatives, the Business Analyst is expected to utilise AI\-enabled tools and techniques to accelerate business analysis, process discovery, requirements gathering, documentation production, testing activities and overall delivery execution while maintaining governance, quality and compliance standards.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirements \& Analysis**

* Engage with stakeholders to gather, analyse, validate and document business requirements.
* Produce clear and structured documentation including Process Design Documents (PDDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, business cases, use cases and process maps.
* Analyse current business processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and opportunities for optimisation, automation and AI adoption.
* Evaluate new technologies, automation opportunities and AI capabilities, ensuring strong business cases and measurable benefits.
* Act as the bridge between business teams, technology teams, data teams and operations functions.
* Leverage AI\-powered analysis tools to accelerate requirements gathering, documentation creation and impact assessments.
* Apply data\-driven analysis techniques to identify opportunities for process improvement and business value creation.

**Process \& Workflow Design**

* Own the definition and design of future\-state operating models and workflows.
* Model business processes using Business Optix or equivalent process modelling platforms.
* Facilitate workshops, interviews and discovery sessions with stakeholders across multiple business functions and locations.
* Ensure all process changes follow appropriate governance, change control and documentation standards.
* Take ownership of process and tool design on behalf of business stakeholders and secure approval.

**Automation, AI \& Agentic Capabilities**

* Support the design and delivery of RPA and intelligent automation solutions.
* Collaborate with technical teams to integrate AI, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs and Agentic AI capabilities into business processes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for decision support, document processing, workflow orchestration, knowledge management and conversational experiences.
* Elicit, document and validate requirements for Agentic AI solutions, including governance controls, escalation paths and human\-in\-the\-loop processes.
* Support the design of digital workers and multi\-agent workflows that automate end\-to\-end business processes.
* Work closely with Automation Developers, AI Engineers and Solution Architects to translate business needs into scalable solutions.
* Maintain awareness of emerging automation and AI technologies and assess their applicability to business challenges.

**UAT Ownership**

* Create and manage the full UAT lifecycle, including test strategies, plans, scripts and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate UAT execution with business users and stakeholders.
* Ensure defects are logged, triaged and resolved efficiently.
* Validate that delivered solutions meet business, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Leverage AI\-assisted testing tools to generate test cases, test scenarios and regression coverage.
* Support automation testing initiatives and intelligent quality assurance practices.
* Establish traceability between requirements, testing activities and delivered outcomes.
* Provide clear reporting on quality, risks and production readiness.

**Delivery \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support delivery teams throughout design, build, testing and implementation phases.
* Monitor project progress and ensure alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Develop strong relationships across Operations, Technology, Risk and Business functions.
* Support change adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Coach stakeholders in identifying and prioritising automation and AI opportunities.
* Promote efficient use of AI\-enabled delivery tools within transformation projects.

**Essential Skills \& Experience**

**Technical \& Analytical**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within change, transformation or technology programmes.
* Strong requirements gathering, process analysis and documentation skills.
* Experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or equivalent enterprise AI solutions.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs and ensure quality and accuracy.
* Experience with process modelling and BPM tools.
* Experience supporting or designing RPA and automation solutions.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using Excel, SQL, Jira and reporting tools.
* Experience in process re\-engineering and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build business cases and conduct cost\-benefit analysis.
* Strong planning, organisation and delivery management skills.

**AI \& Automation Skills**

* Understanding of AI, Machine Learning, LLMs, VLMs and Agentic AI concepts.
* Ability to identify and quantify AI opportunities within business processes.
* Strong experience with conversational AI, copilots and intelligent automation platforms.
* Understanding of process mining and task mining concepts.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, model limitations and governance practices.
* Awareness of AI\-related data privacy, security and compliance considerations.

**Personal \& Professional**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building capability.
* Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
* Innovative and pragmatic problem\-solving mindset.
* Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive change.
* Self\-motivated individual with strong ownership and accountability.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

* Experience within Asset Management, Wealth Management, Life \& Pensions or Financial Services.
* Knowledge of UK collective investments and third\-party administration models.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
* Lean Six Sigma, ECBA, CBAP or equivalent qualifications.
* Experience with a variety of AI platforms.
* Exposure to process mining technologies.
* Experience supporting Agentic AI or AI\-enabled transformation programmes.
* Exposure to development technologies such as SQL Server, C\#, Java, VBA, HTML or CSS.
Experience with Blue Prism, UiPath or equivalent automation technologies.

title: Data Analyst - Lead
description:
Lead analyst would be working with global stakeholders on analysis of vertical performance \& other ad\-hoc analysis for strategic customers of FedEx.  

Expected to provide expert thought leadership at the enterprise level related to designs and implements advanced processes and analytics associated with a wide variety of data sets used for data/text mining, analysis, and prediction to enable informed business decisions. Gains insight into key business problems and deliverables by applying highly technical analysis techniques to examine structured and unstructured data from multiple disparate sources.
  

Should possess and demonstrate understanding of core Business and Commercial concepts including financial metrics, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes.  

Communicates results to a broad range of audiences. Effectively uses current and emerging technologies to evaluate trends and develop actionable insights and recommendations to management, via understanding of the business model and the information available for analysis.

 **Grade :T7**

**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**

  

As a **Lead Measurement Analyst**, you will be the strategic architect, operational manager, and subject matter expert (SME) driving our commercial performance measurement framework. Operating within the Commercial Analytics and Performance division, you will lead the end\-to\-end design, execution, delivery, and project management of sophisticated analytics that track FedEx global vertical performance.


You will translate complex database queries and advanced statistical models into high\-level business justifications and executive\-level narratives. Serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, you will synthesize past, present, and future commercial trends to guide marketing, forecasting, and commercial business strategies. Additionally, you will champion analytical standards, distribute work tasks, manage delivery timelines, clear operational roadblocks, and mentor team members to foster a high\-performing culture of data\-driven decision\-making.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Vertical Performance**

* Own the end\-to\-end measurement framework for tracking global performance across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Lead deep\-dive analyses into critical revenue drivers, isolating trends in volume, pricing, and yield—specifically monitoring and developing strategies to address yield compression and regional performance variations.
* Design and champion the architecture of advanced Power BI dashboards and executive scorecards, establishing data modelling and reporting standards across the team.
* Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence partners to optimize enterprise data structures, ensuring consistent data pipelines and high\-integrity reporting environments.

**Executive Consultation \& Narrative Delivery**

* Author and present high\-impact, narrative\-driven business reviews and strategic performance updates directly to executive leadership (e.g., CEO updates, senior staff briefings, and quarterly reviews).
* Translate complex statistical anomalies and commercial trends into clear, executive\-ready "so\-what" insights, detailing the *past* drivers, *present* status, and *future* outlook.
* Formulate data\-driven business cases and pricing/revenue simulations to support strategic adjustments in vertical targeting and market positioning.

**Advanced Statistics, AI, \& Cohort Modelling**

* Direct the implementation of advanced statistical methodologies (such as cohort analysis, regression, and pattern recognition) to identify and explain hidden trends in transactional datasets.
* Drive the business application of AI/Machine Learning models, leveraging clustering algorithms and predictive frameworks to refine customer cohorts, automate industry vertical tracking, and capture emerging micro\-trends.
* Partner with forecasting, marketing, and finance leaders to align historical performance models with forward\-looking growth forecasts and strategic demand plans.

**Team Leadership, Project Delivery, \& Governance**

* **Task Distribution \& Backlog Management:** Manage the intake of analytical requests, prioritize competing demands, and strategically distribute work packages across team members to align with individual strengths and project requirements.
* **Timeline Tracking \& Progress Reporting:** Track delivery milestones for major reporting cycles and ad\-hoc analytics projects, ensuring consistent execution and providing progress and bandwidth updates to department leadership.
* **Roadblock Resolution:** Act as a proactive buffer for the sub\-team, stepping in to resolve technical hurdles, cross\-functional data dependency bottlenecks, or query limitations by collaborating with IT, Data Engineering, and product groups.
* **Process Optimization \& Automation:** Continuously refine, standardize, and automate recurring analytics processes to reduce reporting cycle times and increase overall team responsiveness.
* **Mentorship \& Quality Control:** Establish and govern analytical standards, documentation, and query\-optimization practices, providing peer reviews and technical mentoring to mid\- and junior\-level analysts.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience \& Background**

* **7\+ years of progressive experience** in business intelligence, commercial analytics, revenue management, or financial measurement.
* Proven experience in a "Lead", Project Lead, or senior consulting capacity, showcasing the ability to manage project pipelines, track timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional resources.
* Extensive experience querying large\-scale enterprise relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, BigQuery) and building advanced visualization frameworks.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating the successful translation of complex analytical findings into executive level presentations and business cases.

**Core Competencies**

* **Operational \& Delivery Leadership:** Excellent capacity to organize project plans, delegate tasks, track delivery timelines, and maintain team output while actively mitigating risks and clearing technical roadblocks.
* **Strategic Influence \& Executive Storytelling:** Exceptional ability to synthesize complex, multi\-layered data into clear, persuasive, and action\-oriented narratives for senior executives.
* **Analytical Leadership \& Rigor:** High\-level problem\-solving capability; a track record of formulating robust business hypotheses and establishing rigorous standards for data integrity and statistical validity.
* **Consultative Stakeholder Management:** Ability to collaborate seamlessly with senior directors and cross\-functional teams (Sales, Finance, Pricing, and Marketing) across global time zones.
* **Innovation \& Change Champion:** Proactive approach to adopting new technologies (such as GenAI, machine learning, and automation tools) to optimize legacy reporting systems.

**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**

* **Analytics \& Data Modelling:** Expert proficiency in **SQL** (required) paired with strong data architecture and modelling skills.
* **Advanced Applied Statistics:** Mastery of statistical concepts (e.g., sampling, significance, correlation, predictive modelling) applied directly to commercial cohorts and behavioural segmentations.
* **Business AI \& Machine Learning:** Practical experience leveraging machine learning concepts (e.g., clustering algorithms, decision trees, NLP/text analytics) to drive customer segmentation, automate tracking, and isolate performance anomalies.
* **Data Visualization:** Advanced development skills in **Power BI** or similar enterprise\-grade visualization suites.
* **Programming \& Automation:** Strong proficiency in **Python** or **R** to build reproducible data models, script automation pipelines, and execute advanced analytics.
* **Productivity \& Presentation:** Expert command of MS Excel (advanced modelling) and PowerPoint (drafting highly polished, visually compelling slides for leadership reviews).

**Certifications** ***(nice to have)***

* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Analytics Professional (CAP), Agile/Scrum certification, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or equivalent.

  

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------


FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
